parent_question: Measure whether reusing exact decoded float32 features through a row-major mmap amortizes repeated SequenceFile Parquet decode and materialization on the bounded valid_subset20 cohort.

scope.kind: CPU storage and decode systems profile
scope.feature_column_order_source: src/wnn/data.py::FEATURE_COLUMNS; exact imported names and their SHA-256 are frozen in E528_FROZEN_INPUT_RECEIPT_V1.json before timing
scope_exclusions: No model fit, GPU work, labels, scored masks, targets, metric or public-score claim
No full training cache; raw float32 feature payload for 10,535 sequences is approximately 94.3936 GB and exceeds current free disk
No extrapolation from this 20-sequence subset to full train, remote staging or end-to-end fit wall time

methods.parquet_decode: For each local row-group position 0..19 in valid_subset20.parquet, call src.wnn.data.SequenceFile.read(position, targets=False, mask=False).features. The saved group array records the original source-group identity and fixes the subset-file order; local positions are not those original group IDs. This uses the training reader's seq_ix + exact FEATURE_COLUMNS selection, pyarrow read_row_group(use_threads=False), stack(axis=0), float32 conversion, transpose and np.ascontiguousarray copy.
methods.mmap_reuse: Build one NPY-format C-order float32 array from those exact SequenceFile outputs in the same saved row-group order, then replay read-only per-sequence views through numpy.load(mmap_mode='r').
methods.common_consumer_touch: Immediately after each sequence fetch, run np.sum(features, dtype=np.float64); this touches every feature value in both methods. Record fetch-only and fetch-plus-full-scan latency separately; complete epoch wall includes the common scan.
methods.parity_gate: Before replay timing, decode every source group again and require exact uint32-view equality for every cached float32 element, identical shape/dtype/contiguity, matching seq_ix order and matching canonical feature-payload SHA-256.
methods.schedule: Replay epoch counts K=1,2,4,8 with 2 repetitions each; fixed seed 20261007 randomizes K/repetition scheduling and parquet-versus-mmap block order; within every epoch preserve the frozen group order.

cache.format: NPY v1/v2-compatible header + little-endian float32 C-order payload
cache.build_timing: SequenceFile open, memmap allocation, decode-and-copy for all groups, flush and fsync; report separately from one-time parity validation and read-only mmap open.
cache.break_even: For this subset only, compare setup_seconds + K * mmap_median_epoch_seconds against K * parquet_median_epoch_seconds; setup_seconds includes cache build, cache-file SHA-256, exact parity validation and mmap/validation-reader opens. Source input identity hashing is timed and reported separately. Report the first integer K satisfying strict improvement, otherwise null. Transfer and training compute are excluded.

timing_and_page_cache.cache_policy: Do not drop global or per-file page cache. The first timed pass is post-build/post-parity and its kernel page-cache state is unknown; record it as first observed replay, not cold. Subsequent passes are repeated replays after prior accesses, not a controlled cold/warm comparison.

resource_admission.systemd_or_dbus: not required; use taskset + prlimit + timeout fallback if user-scope bus is unavailable

success_criteria: Input hashes and exact source reader/feature-order hashes are recorded before timings
All 20 groups have the frozen row order, complete 20,000-row shape and one seq_ix each
Cached payload is within 250,000,000 bytes and passes exact full-array parity
The bounded profile exits 0 within 180 seconds, with observed peak process RSS below 1,000,000,000 bytes
Actual cache build, parity, mmap open, replay p50/p90, wall time, output disk bytes and subset-only break-even/null are reported
